title: Rosemary Beach "Memories on Water" 325 West Water Street Main House
h1: Rosemary Beach "Memories on Water" 325 West Water Street Main House
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Steps to the white sand beaches and world class Rosemary Beach restaurants- Perfect location – 3 minute walk to the private beach, 3 minute walk to shops and restaurants (relax at home as you await the text that your table is ready!)- Amazing Gulf view balcony- perfect for connecting with family, having a morning coffee or happy hour cocktail- Large, serene bedrooms – each with full bathroom, king size beds and patios- Design magazine décor – chef’s kitchen, high-end appliances, and furniture, dining table for 8, stunning fireplace, vaulted beamed ceilings- Access to a community pool right across the street with both sun and shade reclining- Private parking for one vehicle inside the garage only, 4 adult bikes, and a private courtyard- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkoutDETAILS: Guests will love Memories on Water, a serene 4-bedroom, 4.5-bathroom Rosemary Beach home that sleeps 9. South of 30A and mere steps from Rosemary’s famous beach, guests will relish the lush landscaping, a balcony with Gulf views, luxe furnishings, and being steps from neighborhood pools, dining, and shopping.A primary bedroom, bunk room, and guest bedroom on the first floor enjoy quick access to a lush outdoor courtyard with a fire-pit and the peaceful sounds of a fountain. The primary bedroom has a king bed, makeup vanity, and a private bathroom with glistening green glass tiles, large soaking tub with jets, and a glass-enclosed shower with double shower heads. A guest bedroom has a romantic 4-poster king bed and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. Younger guests will enjoy the bunk rooms queen-over-queen bunk bed, and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo.Dramatic exposed ceiling beams on the second floor pull the eye up to the beautiful arched ceilings. An open kitchen, dining, and living space enjoy lots of natural light and open to a balcony with views of Rosemary Beach. A sofa and comfy armchairs surround a dramatic fireplace in a living area dotted with seashells and coastal accents. Premium appliances, marble countertops, and a center island that seats 4 complete a beautiful chef’s kitchen. A dining table seats 8. Tucked behind the kitchen is a guest bedroom with a king bed and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. A smaller den gives guests a private area to relax on a wrap-around sofa, play games, or enjoy a movie.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:-Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and Tub-Guest Bedroom: Queen over Queen Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub Combo-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:-Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
